displayName: Block apps from exposing app functions
description: If 'True', apps on fully managed devices, and apps in the work profile on corporate-owned devices with a work profile, are blocked from exposing app functions. If 'False', apps are allowed to expose app functions, which is the default OS behavior. Available for fully managed, dedicated, and corporate-owned work profile devices (at work profile level).

options.description: Apps are allowed to expose app functions.
Apps are blocked from exposing app functions.
